examples.title: Dry run: what would be extracted?

description: Extract with every engine guard ON unless you name the relaxation: zip-slip / absolute / drive / UNC / NUL / ADS / Windows-device names → ZIP_PATH_TRAVERSAL (rejectTraversal:false SKIPS them, listed in `skipped`; an unsafe path is never emitted); symlinks → ZIP_SYMLINK_REJECTED (rejectSymlinks:false extracts the target text as data, never a link); duplicate sanitized paths → ZIP_EXTRACT_DUPLICATE_PATH (onDuplicate 'first' | 'last'); declared sizes / ratios beyond `limits` → ZIP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; overlapping entries and central/local divergence are always refused. `filter` keeps a subset. outputMode 'base64' (default) returns files inline (≤ 16 MiB each, ≤ 32 MiB total; includeData:false = dry run of the plan); 'file' streams into a relative `outputDir` inside ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR (never overwrites) and returns resource links. Directories are implied by paths (emptyDirectories:true creates the explicit ones). The dry run opens eagerly: an overlapping, offset-into-CD or Zip64-spoofed archive is refused before any plan is returned. Prefer read_zip_entry for a single file.

emptyDirectories.description: file mode: also create explicit directory entries (with a safe name) that hold no file.

fields.description: Dot-paths to keep, after verbosity (e.g. ['entryCount', 'entries.name']); unmatched ones are listed in _meta.unmatchedFields.

filter.description: Select entries: `names` (exact), `prefix`, `glob` (`*` in a segment, `**` across, `?`, `[a-z]`; no `/` = any depth, trailing `/` = subtree), ANDed; `includeDirectories` (default false).

glob.description: Patterns (≤ 1024 characters); ANY match keeps the entry (e.g. ['**/*.json', 'docs/']).

includeDirectories.description: Keep explicit directory entries (names ending in `/`).

names.description: Exact entry names to keep (case-sensitive; every duplicate of a name is kept).

prefix.description: Keep entries whose name starts with this prefix (e.g. 'src/').

includeData.description: base64 mode: false = dry run — list what WOULD be extracted (paths, sizes) without decompressing or returning bytes.

limits.description: Per-call override of zipnative's security bounds (CWE-400/409); absent keys keep the engine defaults (describe_engine.defaultLimits). A value above its operator ceiling is LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED. Raise only for trusted input.

maxEntryCompressedSize.description: Bytes, one compressed payload fetched by the byte-range reader (access range).

onDuplicate.description: Two entries mapping to the same sanitized path: 'error' (default, ZIP_EXTRACT_DUPLICATE_PATH), keep the 'first', or keep the 'last'.

outputDir.description: Relative directory inside the sandbox to extract into (file mode; created if absent; no absolute paths, no '..').

outputMode.description: 'base64' (default): files inline (≤ 16777216 bytes each, ≤ 33554432 bytes total). 'file': stream every file under outputDir inside ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR (never overwrites) and return resource links.

rejectSymlinks.description: true (default): a symlink entry fails the call with ZIP_SYMLINK_REJECTED. false: its target text is extracted as ordinary data (never materialised as a link).

rejectTraversal.description: true (default): an entry whose name escapes the root (zip-slip, absolute, drive/UNC, NUL, ADS, Windows device name) fails the call with ZIP_PATH_TRAVERSAL. false: such entries are SKIPPED and listed in `skipped` — an unsafe path is never emitted either way.

strict.description: Turn the first engine diagnostic into a ZIP_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error.

verbosity.description: 'summary': scalar verdict fields only (the token-frugal form).

zipBase64.description: Archive bytes, base64 (≤ 128 MiB decoded). Exclusive with zipPath.

zipPath.description: Archive path relative to the ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (container extensions: .zip .jar .docx .epub …). Exclusive with zipBase64; saves re-sending bytes between calls.

name: extract_zip

outputSchema.description: Extraction result (inline files, a dry-run plan, or written files). Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

diagnosticCount.description: summary only: number of distinct diagnostics.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal engine concerns (de-duplicated by code + entry, ≤ 200; codes in describe_engine.diagnosticCodes). Empty for a clean archive.

diagnosticsTruncated.description: true when rows beyond 200 were dropped.

dryRun.description: true when includeData was false: nothing was decompressed.

entries.description: One row per extracted file, in central-directory order. base64 mode carries dataBase64 (unless dryRun); file mode carries filePath.

skipped.description: Entries skipped because their name is unsafe (only with rejectTraversal:false).

skippedCount.description: summary only: number of skipped (unsafe-path) entries.

totalBytes.description: Sum of the extracted (or planned) uncompressed sizes.

title: Extract (secure by default)
